test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: WPKD is related to BUPI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, QJEX is related to VOJC. To which of the given options is FYTM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

The pattern established is: **(First Word) + 5 → (Second Word)**.

For, WPKD is related to BUPI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c87b83560969d9c864fb817bdc4e19f12d291e8c834ac8620c1ef712e514f711.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d60a0402cb866199e7b150b3edbb8594f2b04eef87e7e70b2c730355aafa685.png] 

For, QJEX is related to VOJC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c73b6c4f2f4a4275ad76bbd1aa084445b33495ec6720d558242ac0a2873955f9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee732490bd1f0e6c61808da25593355f18cac6a8faf10ee176c72acc9cae691e.png] 

Similarly, for **FYTM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4656d999d9d88ddd2f93d98e3895f69594c9fe4c507c1d1e224d31706c75e8be.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37ba1b1b4520b3165402ec33454ac0f3effb2338d80ddb25ff17b758b8c344a6.png] 

So, FYTM will be written as **KDYR**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
